long_biography.plain_text:
Born in Westerly, Rhode Island, Alfiero learned to fly as a teenager and served as a Marine Corps fighter pilot with VMA-214. After active duty, he completed engineering studies at Rensselaer and earned an MBA from Harvard, bringing technical training and financial discipline to his next venture.

Alfiero founded the business that became Mark IV Industries in 1969. With Clement Arrison, he built an acquisition-led manufacturing group spanning automotive components, industrial products and transport systems, remaining chairman and chief executive until its sale three decades later. He then led P I Ventures and continued board service, while family philanthropy supported education, health care, children, older people and military veterans. Alfiero died in 2022.
